learning_objective: 🔬 Understand the physics behind the magic! Learn how invisible sound waves create pitch, volume, and the unique colors of musical notes.

आवृत्ति (एक सेकंड में होने वाले कंपनों की संख्या, जो पिच तय करती है)
आयाम (ध्वनि तरंग की ऊंचाई, जो आवाज़ का भारीपन/Volume तय करती है)

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Sound is a mechanical wave that needs a medium (like air, water, or wood) to travel. When a guitar string is plucked, it vibrates the air molecules around it, sending invisible waves to our eardrums.

Frequency is how fast a sound wave vibrates, measured in Hertz (Hz). A fast vibration (high frequency) creates a high-pitched sound (like a whistle). A slow vibration creates a low-pitched sound (like a bass drum).
Amplitude is the size or height of the sound wave. Larger amplitude means more energy, creating a louder sound. Smaller amplitude makes a softer sound.

Why does a piano sound different from a violin, even when playing the exact same note? It's because of 'Timbre'. Every instrument produces a complex mix of the main note (fundamental) and tiny hidden notes (harmonics or overtones).

Resonance is when an object naturally vibrates at the same frequency as a sound wave, making the sound louder. The hollow wooden body of a guitar acts as a 'resonator' to amplify the quiet sound of the vibrating strings.

fun_activity.title: 🎸 The Rubber Band Guitar
fun_activity.instructions: Stretch a rubber band between your thumb and index finger. Pluck it. Now, stretch it tighter and pluck it again. Notice how the pitch goes up? Tighter tension means faster frequency, which equals a higher pitch!

exam_tips: 📌 Distinguish clearly between Frequency (determines Pitch) and Amplitude (determines Volume).
📌 The human ear can typically hear frequencies between 20 Hz and 20,000 Hz.
📌 Music vs. Noise: Musical sounds have regular, repeating wave patterns, while noise consists of irregular, chaotic wave patterns.
quick_recap: ⭐ The unit of measurement for frequency is Hertz (Hz), and for loudness, it is Decibels (dB).
⭐ Timbre is what allows us to recognize a friend's voice on the phone without seeing them.
⭐ Without a medium (like in the vacuum of space), sound waves cannot travel.
